title: Applying for heavy vehicle access permits (B-doubles and HML vehicles)
summary: This page provides information on applying for heavy vehicle access permits for B-doubles and HML vehicles through the National Heavy Vehicle Regulator (NHVR).

faqs.q: Where can I apply for a heavy vehicle access permit?
faqs.a: You can apply for heavy vehicle access permits through the National Heavy Vehicle Regulator (NHVR) portal, NHVR Go.

faqs.q: Does the NHVR permit cover all areas?
faqs.a: The NHVR permit applies to travel throughout Australia, but you must apply directly to the relevant state or territory road transport authority if you are operating in Western Australia or the Northern Territory.

faqs.q: What if I am operating a Performance-Based Standards (PBS) vehicle at HML?
faqs.a: If you are operating a Performance-Based Standards vehicle at HML, you must apply for a Performance-Based Standards (PBS) access permit.
